message: '.position' cannot be written through an entity_ref.
notes: an entity_ref does not name the entity, so a write could not be checked against that entity's body and its bindings
help: write a named entity's field, or move a spawned body with `r.body.teleport` or `r.body.apply_impulse`

message: '.hits' cannot be read through an entity_ref. Only `position`, `rotation`, `scale` and `visible` can.
notes: state, material params and other fields stay on the named entity, because an entity_ref does not say which entity it will be
help: read `position`, `rotation`, `scale` or `visible`, or keep the value in scene state
